facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.run_semantic_instance_evaluation: run the evaluate_semantic_instance.py script with --pred_path and --gt_path to evaluate 3D semantic instance segmentation on ScanNet scans

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.evaluate_matches: evaluate matched prediction and ground truth instances to compute average precision scores across overlap thresholds
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.assign_instances_for_scan: assign predicted instances to ground truth instances for a single scan by computing vertex-level intersections
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.write_to_benchmark: write prediction instances and masks to the benchmark output format for ScanNet instance segmentation submission

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.run_semantic_label_evaluation: run the CLI to evaluate semantic label predictions against ground truth for ScanNet scans

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.update_confusion_matrix: update the confusion matrix by comparing predicted IDs against ground truth IDs for a scan
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.evaluate_confusion_and_write_results: evaluate the accumulated confusion matrix and write per-class IoU scores and confusion matrix to a file
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.get_iou_for_class: get the IoU score for a specific label ID using true positives, false positives, and false negatives

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.read_label_mapping: read a tab-delimited CSV file and return a dictionary mapping labels from one column to integer values in another
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.read_scene_types_mapping: read a tab-delimited text file and return a dictionary mapping scene type names to integer IDs
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.visualize_label_image: create a colorized visualization of a label segmentation numpy array and save it as an image file
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.visualize_instance_image: create a colorized visualization of an instance segmentation numpy array with unique colors per instance and save it
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.represents_int: check if a given string can be safely parsed as an integer and return a boolean result

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.transform_points_3d: transform a set of 3D points using a 4x4 transformation matrix with perspective division
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.read_mesh_vertices_ply: read mesh vertices from a PLY file and return them as a numpy array of xyz coordinates
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.export_instance_ids_for_eval: export 3D instance labels and predicted masks for ScanNet instance segmentation evaluation
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.read_instance_prediction_file: read and parse an instance prediction file with mask paths, label IDs, and confidence scores
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.get_instances_by_class: get all instances grouped by class label from mesh vertex instance IDs and class mappings
